caption: The drawing depicts a textile or fabric piece with a decorative design, where the main field is a rich turquoise-blue color bordered by two vertical brown panels on the left and right sides. The composition features a botanical motif in the center: a brownish stem with greenish-yellow, jagged-edged leaves, and three main flowers. Two of the flowers are round, fluffy, and pale off-white in color, while the third flower is a large, dense cluster of elongated petals in a bright reddish hue positioned at the upper right. The edges of the textile have a multicolored, braided trim, and several loose threads are visible extending from the upper edge. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and there is a small handwritten signature "Mary L. M. Sneadlee" located toward the lower right area of the image.
title: Fireplace Screen
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
